name: Tsuki e no Tegami
source:
Every night, Noa writes letters to the moon. She never expected a reply… until today.

[From [url=https://code-n-bloom.itch.io/tsuki-e-no-tegami]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每天晚上，诺亚都会给月亮写信。她从来没想过会得到答复……直到今天。

[来自[url=https://code-n-bloom.itch.io/tsuki-e-no-tegami]itch.io[/url]]
